about: Re-experience the 2017 arcade classic with 3 additional stages and 6 additional boss battles! Take control of Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello or Raphael in this classic beat-em-up inspired by the cult favorite Turtles in Time.
Play with your friends through local co-op and dominate the Foot Clan to foil the Shredder’s maniacal plan.

• Re-experience the Classic Arcade Game: with 3 additional stages and 6 additional bosses never-before-seen in the classic 2017 arcade • Play as the 4 Turtles: From the 2012 cartoon featuring Leo, Mikey, Donnie, and Raph.
summary: Defeat the Mutants and Save New York
